title: Suspicious PowerShell Spawned from Outlook

  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4688
detection:
  selection:
    New_Process_Name|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    Creator_Process_Name|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    Command_Line|contains: '-nop -w hidden -encodedcommand'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
description: Detects encoded PowerShell launched directly from Outlook, commonly seen in phishing payloads.

rule UnsignedDLL_Loaded_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects unsigned DLLs loaded from user Temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        date = "2026-04-12"
    strings:
        $temp_path = /\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]+\\.dll/i
    condition:
        $temp_path and not pe.signed()
}
